pos.personaBrief: Palmeiras did not take permanent initiative and valued practicality (Coaches' Voice 2021); mid/low block with fast transitions, so ball possession is not an aim in itself.

pro.personaBrief: Low-risk play in own zones, direct ball to forwards, vertical transitions and counters (Coaches' Voice, Observador); but three-man first line and short touches to attract the press show some patience.

est.personaBrief: Structured 3-4-3/4-2-3-1 with short distances between lines and defined roles (Scarpa as wing-back), yet wide attackers moving inside and a box of four behind Rony.

lar.personaBrief: Wing-backs create overloads and fast wide attackers exploit space, but the 2021 final used a box of four with wide attackers pushed inside and a compact double pivot.

blo.personaBrief: Medium/low block, deep five-man defence and passive early defending (TFA, Inside World Football), with perde-pressiona and selective pressing on goal kicks and back passes.

mar.personaBrief: Mixed: individual references when pressing goal kicks and a dedicated task for Scarpa on Isla, but compact zonal block with midfielders watching between the lines; set-piece routines unknown.

pla.personaBrief: Abel adapted to each opponent (Isla threat, back to three for the final, chess game), accused of overthinking the rival (Trivela), and studies a lot.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic, result-first team: back five, shutting games, 18 clean sheets, two titles in four months; stated focus on objectives over result anxiety but still practicality.

sis.personaBrief: A collective system with defined roles for all (attacking midfielder Scarpa dropping to defend, Dudu and Rony tracking), players know what to do; no free stars.

jog.personaBrief: Fast attackers for transitions, aggressive centre-backs, Danilo and Zé Rafael giving little space; intensity and duels matter but technique in a collective frame.

bas.personaBrief: Abel is a developer who boosts young talents (Gabriel Menino) but the title side leaned on experienced signings (Luiz Adriano, Dudu, Weverton) and a rotating squad.

lid.personaBrief: Abel is restless, strict and in charge, with a way of life philosophy; players praise his study and clarity of roles, rules apply to all.
